quiz.q: A customer bought a jar of cream that lasts most people about 6 weeks. When is the best time to send a reorder reminder?
options: The next day
Six months later
Never, she will come back if she wants
About 5 weeks after purchase, before she runs out
quiz.explain: Time reminders for just before the product usually runs out, so the message is useful, not pushy.

quiz.q: Ngozi's breakfast costs her ₦700 and sells for ₦1,200. With 'buy 9, get the 10th free', what profit does she make over 10 breakfasts?
When is the best moment to ask for a referral?
options: Before the customer has received her order
Right after she expresses satisfaction or praise
When she complains
Only at the end of the year
quiz.explain: Satisfaction is highest right after a good experience, so she is most willing to recommend you.

quiz.q: Which referral reward is most appropriate for a small business?
options: Paying people mainly to recruit others who must recruit more
Promising large cash payouts
A modest discount or free item for customers whose referrals buy
Requiring customers to refer before they can buy
quiz.explain: A modest thank-you rewards genuine referrals. Recruitment-based schemes can become pyramid schemes.

quiz.q: Which target is best for a 90-day plan?
options: Be better with customers
Become the best seller in Nigeria
Get more sales somehow
Increase repeat customers from 12 of 25 to at least 15 of 25 a month
quiz.explain: Good targets are measurable and based on your own starting numbers.

quiz.q: You want to post a customer's WhatsApp praise on your status. What must you do?
options: Ask her permission and hide her number
Post it as it is with her number visible
Edit it to sound more impressive
Post it without her name but add extra praise
quiz.explain: Testimonials need permission, real words and hidden contact details.

finalQuiz.q: A customer says she needs a blender because grinding pepper by hand for her food business takes too long. What is her need?
options: A 1.5 litre jar
The cheapest blender
Saving time and effort in her food business
A blender in her favourite colour
finalQuiz.explain: The jar size is a feature. Her need is to save time in her business; link your recommendation to that.

finalQuiz.q: Which habit is NOT part of active listening?
options: Reflecting what you heard
Summarising and confirming
Asking open questions
Interrupting to explain your product early
finalQuiz.explain: Active listening is attend, ask, reflect, summarise. Interrupting stops you learning the real need.

finalQuiz.q: A buyer collecting a ₦50,000 order shows a transfer screenshot. Your app shows nothing yet. What do you do?
options: Politely wait until the money shows in your own account
Release the goods; the screenshot is enough
Ask for an SMS alert instead
Give half the goods
finalQuiz.explain: Screenshots and SMS can be faked. Only money visible in your own account counts.

finalQuiz.q: Which is step 3 of the six-step sales conversation?
options: Follow up
Recommend with benefits linked to the need
Greet warmly
Agree the order
finalQuiz.explain: Greet, ask and listen, recommend with benefits, answer concerns, agree the order, follow up.

finalQuiz.q: A customer says 'Let me think about it.' What is the best reply?
options: 'Okay, bye.'
'This price ends today!' (when it does not)
'Of course. Is there anything you are not sure about that I can explain now?'
Immediately offer 30% off
finalQuiz.explain: 'Let me think about it' often hides a worry. Clarify it without pressure.

finalQuiz.q: If you agree to lower a price, what is the good practice?
options: Lower it every time anyone asks
Go below your cost to win the sale
Raise the price for the next customer
Trade something in return, such as smaller size or no delivery
finalQuiz.explain: Protect your margin: change something in return and never sell below your lowest acceptable price.

finalQuiz.q: A cake arrives damaged. Which response follows LAST?
options: Listen fully, apologise sincerely, agree a fix such as a replacement or partial refund, then thank her
Explain the rider was careless and it is not your fault
Offer a refund before she finishes speaking
Ask her to post a review
finalQuiz.explain: Listen, Apologise, Solve, Thank. Then fix the cause, such as the delivery method.

finalQuiz.q: Which is a clear, measurable service standard?
options: We care about customers
We confirm every order in writing before taking payment
We are the best in town
We try to be fast
finalQuiz.explain: A standard is specific enough to check whether you kept it.

finalQuiz.q: Which caption is ethical for a body cream?
options: 'Cures eczema in 3 days!'
'Original from UK' when it is made locally
'Rich shea butter cream for dry skin. Patch test if you have sensitive skin.'
'Only 2 left!' when you have 40
finalQuiz.explain: Describe true benefits and avoid medical, false origin and fake scarcity claims.

finalQuiz.q: In May you had 20 different customers, 9 of whom had bought before. What share were repeat customers?
A loyal customer praises your work in a voice note. What is the best next step?
options: Thank her, ask permission to share her words, and ask if she knows anyone who might need your service
Post her voice note publicly at once
Send her ten promotional messages
Ask her to pay a referral fee
finalQuiz.explain: Satisfaction is the best moment for a testimonial and referral request, always with permission.

finalQuiz.q: Which 90-day plan is most likely to succeed?
options: Ten new habits started at once
One relationship habit and one sales skill with measurable targets and monthly checks
No plan; just work harder
A target copied from a large company
finalQuiz.explain: Small, specific, measured plans based on your own numbers are the ones people keep.
